data.title: Exact review: correctness oracle control protocol 53845bd6
data.description: Independent exact review of commit 53845bd655642c865037fed1459d3023e0622120 / tree eaf10752c7f44811ddea81d8b307af99248196b6. risk:high failure-mode checklist: phase/nonces/identity/counters/mode routing, digest constants and formatting, per-generation log accounting, legacy-path compatibility, static-test soundness, release-path assertion absence, evaluator integration/schema drift. Static-only: no compiler/build/timing/evidence.

data.body: MEDIUM: The new source-attestation validators prove that counter/timestamp marker spellings are present, but not that each marker is wired to the correct same-typed argument. Independent static probes replaced the correctness-oracle ready call's  values with  and  still accepted it. A second probe swapped / arguments (and substituted  for the counter-start format argument) inside shared ;  also accepted it. These mutations compile at the type level and corrupt evidence semantics while the static approval test reports success. Bind the exact ordered call argument tuple and exact ordered  argument tuple, and add hostile swap/substitution cases. The exact 53845bd runtime wiring itself is correct, so this is an approval-test soundness gap rather than a demonstrated current-child protocol failure.

Clarified reproduction (the prior message lost shell-quoted identifiers): the accepted hostile correctness call rewired the ordered tuple (alloc_before.calls, alloc_before.bytes, cpu_before.user_ns, cpu_before.system_ns, ready_monotonic_ns, counter_start_monotonic_ns) to (alloc_before.bytes, alloc_before.calls, cpu_before.system_ns, cpu_before.user_ns, counter_start_monotonic_ns, ready_monotonic_ns). The accepted hostile shared-control mutation swapped the allocated_bytes_start and allocation_calls_start format arguments and supplied ready_monotonic_ns to the counter_start_monotonic_ns field. Both validators returned normally. Required fix: bind exact ordered arguments in both validators and add these hostile cases.

The same gap also affects the new generation-accounting guard. I supplied a read-only hostile borrowed adapter in which the C seed assertion expected domain_events + 17 instead of domain_events; prepare_overlays.static_self_test still emitted status ok because it checks only that a C arm exists and that the D formula string exists somewhere. Please bind the exact C, D, and current function bodies/expressions and add C/D/full-corpus hostile accounting cases alongside the ordered control-argument cases.

data.reason: APPROVED for exact commit 53845bd655642c865037fed1459d3023e0622120 / tree eaf10752c7f44811ddea81d8b307af99248196b6: runtime protocol/digest/accounting integration is correct and no schema or timed-path drift was found. One MEDIUM approval-test soundness thread remains: same-typed counter/timestamp and C-accounting mutations are not rejected by the new static source validators.
